Botev Plovdiv is a Bulgarian professional football club based in Plovdiv, which competes in the Parva Liga, the top tier of Bulgarian football. Founded on 11 March 1912, it is the oldest active football club in Bulgaria and is widely regarded as one of the country’s historically significant clubs.
